preconditions.description: The size of the chessboard is between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: each integer from 1 to n appears exactly once in p_1, ..., p_n
preconditions.description: Each number from 1 to n appears exactly once on the main diagonal.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output.length == n and all(len(line) == i for i, line in enumerate(output, start=1)))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a list of n lines, each containing i numbers for the i-th line.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or all(all(1 <= x <= n for x in line) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or all(all(line[j-1] == i for j in range(1, i+1)) for i, line in enumerate(output, start=1))
postconditions.description: The i-th line contains the numbers 1 through i, each appearing exactly once.
The output is a valid partition of the board into connected regions that satisfy the given constraints.
